"""Separate observation after the actual closed idle-output retirement."""
from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime, timezone
import os, stat, json, hashlib, collections, importlib.util, sys, traceback
sys.dont_write_bytecode=True
os.environ['GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS']='0'
base=Path('/workspace/scratch/b4a17a285e23/fdsa-restored-20261104'); ctrl=base/'fdsa-control'
out=ctrl/'provenance/idle-generated-output-retirement-execution-20261104'
flags=os.O_RDONLY|os.O_DIRECTORY|os.O_NOFOLLOW|os.O_CLOEXEC
def now():return datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
def dm(s):return [s.st_mode,s.st_dev,s.st_ino,s.st_nlink,s.st_size,s.st_blocks]
def save(n,x):(out/n).write_text(json.dumps(x,indent=2)+'\n')
def ih(h,row):h.update((json.dumps(row,separators=(',',':'))+'\n').encode())
def opened(p):
    fd=os.open('/',flags);anc=[]
    try:
        for name in Path(p).parts[1:]:
            s=os.stat(name,dir_fd=fd,follow_symlinks=False);assert stat.S_ISDIR(s.st_mode)
            nf=os.open(name,flags,dir_fd=fd);z=os.fstat(nf);assert (s.st_dev,s.st_ino)==(z.st_dev,z.st_ino)
            anc.append([name,z.st_dev,z.st_ino]);os.close(fd);fd=nf
        assert anc[2]==['b4a17a285e23',27,2889817]
        return fd,anc
    except:os.close(fd);raise
result={'started_utc':now(),'status':'checking','payload_mutation':False,'new_acceptance':False,'roots':[]}
assert not (out/'persistence-result.json').exists(),'Refuse repeat observation'
save('executed-persistence-method.json',{'kind':'Separate actual one-off observation, retained as data','code':Path(__file__).read_text()})
try:
    terminal=json.loads((out/'owned-terminal.json').read_text());assert terminal['actual_tool_exit']==terminal['actual_operation_exit']==0
    execution=json.loads((out/'execution-result.json').read_text());assert execution['exit']==0 and execution['files_cleared']==17092
    before=json.loads((out/'immediate-preflight.json').read_text());seen=set();total=collections.Counter()
    for old in before['records']:
        root=old['root'];fd,anc=opened(root);rs=os.fstat(fd)
        assert dm(rs)==old['root_identity'] and anc[2:]==old['ancestors'][2:]
        assert (rs.st_dev,rs.st_ino) not in seen;seen.add((rs.st_dev,rs.st_ino))
        counts=collections.Counter();suffix=collections.Counter();dh=hashlib.sha256();fh=hashlib.sha256();times=[]
        def walk(dfd,rel=''):
            for name in sorted(os.listdir(dfd)):
                s=os.stat(name,dir_fd=dfd,follow_symlinks=False);q=rel+'/'+name if rel else name
                assert s.st_dev==rs.st_dev;key=(s.st_dev,s.st_ino);assert key not in seen;seen.add(key)
                if stat.S_ISDIR(s.st_mode):
                    d=dm(s);ih(dh,[q,*d]);counts['directories']+=1;times.append([q,s.st_mtime_ns,s.st_ctime_ns]);nf=os.open(name,flags,dir_fd=dfd)
                    try:assert dm(os.fstat(nf))==d;walk(nf,q)
                    finally:os.close(nf)
                else:
                    assert stat.S_ISREG(s.st_mode) and s.st_nlink==1,(root,q,'not single-link regular')
                    assert s.st_size==0 and s.st_blocks==0,(root,q,'payload not persistently zero',s.st_size,s.st_blocks)
                    ih(fh,[q,s.st_mode,s.st_dev,s.st_ino,s.st_nlink]);counts['files']+=1;counts['apparent_bytes']+=s.st_size;counts['allocated_bytes']+=s.st_blocks*512
                    suffix[''.join(Path(name).suffixes) or '<none>']+=1
        try:walk(fd)
        finally:os.close(fd)
        assert dh.hexdigest()==old['directories_identity_sha256'] and fh.hexdigest()==old['file_identity_sha256_for_persistence']
        assert counts.get('files',0)==old['counts'].get('files',0) and counts.get('directories',0)==old['counts'].get('directories',0)
        assert dict(suffix)==old['suffix_counts']
        result['roots'].append({'root':root,'root_identity':dm(rs),'ancestors':anc,'counts':dict(counts),'file_identity_sha256':fh.hexdigest(),'directories_identity_sha256':dh.hexdigest(),'directory_timestamps_observed':times,'zero_logical_and_allocated_file_payload':True,'unchanged_file_identity_set_and_directory_topology':True})
        total.update(counts)
    assert total['files']==17092 and total['apparent_bytes']==total['allocated_bytes']==0
    spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('checkpoint_readonly',ctrl/'checkpoint_compact.py');cp=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec);spec.loader.exec_module(cp)
    refs=[{'oid':x[0],'ref':x[1],'symref':x[2]} for x in (line.split(' ',2) for line in cp.git(base/'conaled','for-each-ref','--format=%(objectname) %(refname) %(symref)').splitlines())]
    assert refs==before['refs'] and cp.worktrees(base/'conaled')==before['worktrees']
    v=os.statvfs(base)
    result.update({'completed_utc':now(),'status':'persistent_zero_payload_confirmed','exit':0,'totals':dict(total),'git_refs_unchanged':len(refs),'worktree_heads_statuses_source_fingerprints_unchanged':15,'protected_paths_not_mutated':True,'available_bytes':v.f_bavail*v.f_frsize,'raw_free_bytes':v.f_bfree*v.f_frsize,'total_filesystem_bytes':v.f_blocks*v.f_frsize,'global_space_change_not_attributed_solely_to_cleanup':True})
    save('persistence-result.json',result)
    state=json.loads((out/'state.json').read_text());state.update({'status':'retired_unusable','separate_persistence_pending':False,'separate_persistence_completed_utc':result['completed_utc'],'persistent_zero_file_count':17092,'persistent_logical_bytes':0,'persistent_allocated_bytes':0,'availability_after_separate_persistence':{'available_bytes':result['available_bytes'],'raw_free_bytes':result['raw_free_bytes']}});save('state.json',state)
    print(json.dumps({k:v for k,v in result.items() if k!='roots'}))
except BaseException as exc:
    result.update({'exit':1,'completed_utc':now(),'status':'persistence_failed','error':repr(exc),'traceback':traceback.format_exc()});save('persistence-result.json',result);print(json.dumps(result));raise
